desc: Decelerator recoil control and Pachmayr's patented Speed-Mount insert combine to create the most advanced slip-on recoil pad yet. This great looking, new slip-on recoil pad is unmatched by any other hunting pad. In addition, the pad's material and design make installation easier than ever. Best of all, all these features are offered at a price that is no more than other, less advanced pads.
